process_lessons.lesson: Prefer deleting avoidable overlap/retention over process relocation when exact serial recomputation stays inside timing margin.
Parent-only RSS can reward exported process cost; charge the process tree before productizing ownership boundaries.
For transparent codec ownership migration, exact compressed-byte and complete-archive identity are stronger early discriminators than cross-decode compatibility.
Test a cdylib ABI through the produced dynamic library; a Cargo integration-test extern-C proxy links the rlib and can create a false harness failure.
For RSS A/Bs, isolate arms in fresh processes; ru_maxrss is a lifetime high-water mark and same-process arm ordering contaminates the second measurement.
